key_insight: Paper Circle uses a coordinated multi-agent LLM framework with tool integration to automate discovery, assessment, and organization of scientific literature, significantly reducing manual effort for researchers.
problem_solved: Researchers struggle to efficiently find, evaluate, synthesize, and organize rapidly growing scientific literature; Paper Circle addresses the bottleneck of time-consuming literature discovery and review workflows.
method: Multi-agent orchestration: specialized LLM agents handle search, retrieval, evaluation, summarization, and synthesis tasks in a modular pipeline.
Tool-enabled workflows: agents interface with external tools (search APIs, citation extractors, knowledge bases, and UI/organization tools) to gather and structure evidence.
Open-source, extensible framework: configurable agents and components that enable reproducible, customizable literature analysis and collaborative workflows.
impact: Paper Circle speeds up literature reviews and makes discovery and synthesis more reproducible and accessible, helping AI/ML practitioners stay current and make better-informed research decisions.
visual_elements: System architecture diagram showing agent types (search, evaluator, summarizer, organizer) and tool integrations
Workflow timeline: query → retrieval → evaluation → synthesis → organized outputs (notes, summaries, citation graphs)
Before/after comparison chart of time/effort for literature review (manual vs. Paper Circle)
UI mockup or example dashboard showing clustered papers, summaries, and exportable notes
paper_title: Paper Circle: An Open-source Multi-agent Research Discovery and Analysis Framework
paper_authors: Komal Kumar, Aman Chadha, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Hisham Cholakkal
